name: Spiko US T-Bills Money Market Fund
oneLiner: USTBL is Spiko's regulated short-term U.S. Treasury fund tokenized for EU and global investors under an AMF-authorized UCITS money market structure.
collateral: Short-dated U.S. Treasury bills with weighted average maturity under two months, held by a UCITS-compliant short-term money market fund administered under Spiko's AMF authorization
pegMechanism: USD-denominated NAV-accreting share token (ISIN FR001400ODM9) of the Spiko SICAV short-term VNAV money market sub-fund authorised by the AMF, backed exclusively by short-dated U.S. Treasury bills with a regulatory weighted-average maturity ceiling under 60 days; subscription and redemption are KYC-gated to allowlisted wallets through Spiko's transfer agent with a daily 11:30 Paris cutoff settling at the day's published NAV (T+0 / next-business-day for late orders) and a $1k minimum; cross-chain issuance on Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Polygon is relayed through Chainlink CCIP. Prospectus: https://cdn.spiko.finance/legal_docs/EN/Prospectus_Spiko_SICAV_EN.pdf

jurisdiction.license: UCITS Short-Term VNAV Money Market Fund

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Spiko acts as transfer agent for USTBL with permissioned ERC-1967 upgradeable proxy and KYC-gated transfers, retaining freeze and burn authority over fund shares.

mintAuthority.summary: USTBL mint and burn are permission-gated on every deployment. On Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Etherlink and Arbitrum a PermissionManager ADMIN group with exactly one 3-of-6 Safe member authorizes minting and can upgrade both the token and the PermissionManager; on Starknet the same authority is a 3-of-5 Argent multisig; on Stellar it is a single-key account that owns both the token and the PermissionManager, which is the weakest control in the set.

controls.label: USTBL token restricted mint/burn
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294990, implementation = 0x15ea0ec460a0e6847ec0aa8d50a84b3a51b95f74, owner() = 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 (renounced), authority() = 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472 (PermissionManager). Mint and burn are restricted() calls requiring PermissionManager authorization.

controls.label: Spiko PermissionManager authority contract
controls.evidence: ERC1967 UUPS proxy wrapping PermissionManager implementation 0xd3f5f1524e1a472b51374a3ff41b8936eb5b658e. At Ethereum block 25575138 getRequirements(token, mint(address,uint256)) returns mask 0x05 (ADMIN group 0 plus operator group 2) and getRequirements(self, upgradeToAndCall) returns mask 0x01 (ADMIN group 0 only); getGroupAdmins(0) returns 0x01, so only ADMIN administers ADMIN. A complete GroupAdded/GroupRemoved scan for group 0 shows deployer 0xed608cf38968c0ba09676843d90b33dd59dd7375 added at block 19690257 and removed at block 19690268, when 0x4eaa52b6280593a8820c45ce38f974290ae52cea was added. getGroups() at block 25575138 confirms the deployer holds no group and 0x4eaa52b6 holds group 0. The earlier reading that an issuer EOA controls mint and upgrade is superseded: the current ADMIN member is a 3-of-6 Safe.

controls.label: USTBL Arbitrum restricted mint/burn
controls.evidence: Verified on Arbitrum at block 485687744: authority() of the USTBL token returns the Spiko PermissionManager 0xa925c217e4c1c82ee721ebd496d3863d5c2d829a, an EIP-1967 proxy whose implementation is the same PermissionManager code as the Ethereum deployment 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472. Minting is gated by the PermissionManager, as on the other EVM chains.

controls.label: Spiko PermissionManager authority contract (Arbitrum)
controls.evidence: EIP-1967 proxy whose implementation matches the Ethereum PermissionManager code. At Arbitrum block 485896559 getRequirements(token, mint(address,uint256)) returns mask 0x05 (ADMIN group 0 plus operator group 2), getRequirements(token, burn(address,uint256)) returns 0x11 (group 0 plus group 4), and getRequirements for upgradeToAndCall on both the token and this PermissionManager returns 0x01 (ADMIN only). getGroupAdmins(0) returns 0x01. Group-0 membership resolves to exactly one account, the 3-of-6 Safe 0x7843225ba488cf780a4fe2c842b5dc2abcf8a03e; getGroups() confirms deployer 0xed608cf38968c0ba09676843d90b33dd59dd7375 holds no group. Current operator group 2 holds six contract accounts (0x4640a8bf08d5917dcaef42edb14d3e06e1b23f39 plus 0x7430d9d142d811f61b4a2d90d6f3a70a8500bbb7, 0x2f284a29054449eb59ffc7d28f5b7ab7f0d187ed, 0x7ba5d85d9f7460fcaf514ae2553296905cb91423, 0x308f38bca540e1a34fcfa185ae1ac54c254e2370 and 0xc9d26a02bfb80e177af352c3defe68ef5ea924fb), each verified by getGroups().

controls.label: Spiko PermissionManager ADMIN Safe (Ethereum)
controls.capDescription: Sole member of the PermissionManager ADMIN group on Ethereum: can mint directly, grant the operator mint group, and upgrade both the token and the PermissionManager.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25575138 getOwners() returned six owners and getThreshold() returned 3 on this Safe v1.4.1 proxy (masterCopy 0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762). getModulesPaginated(0x1, 10) returned an empty module array and the Safe guard storage slot is zero, so no module or guard bypass exists at the observed block.

controls.label: Spiko PermissionManager ADMIN Safe (Arbitrum)
controls.capDescription: Sole member of the PermissionManager ADMIN group on Arbitrum: can mint directly, grant the operator mint group, and upgrade both the token and the PermissionManager.
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 485896631 getOwners() returned six owners and getThreshold() returned 3 on this Safe v1.4.1 proxy (masterCopy 0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762), and getModulesPaginated(0x1, 10) returned an empty module array. getGroups() at block 485896559 returns group 0 for this address, confirming it is the current ADMIN member.

controls.label: USTBL Starknet restricted mint/burn
controls.capDescription: Starknet USTBL token: mint and burn are gated by the Spiko Starknet PermissionManager, and the token owner can replace the declared class and the permission-manager address.
controls.evidence: At Starknet block 12085430 symbol() returned USTBL, decimals() returned 5 and total_supply() returned 1036596690077 (10,365,966.90077 shares). The declared class 0x5973b1bed1f0a20a9125fac8ec5499f29f44bb70d9c465658c0da20ca9b75f3 exposes mint, burn, pause, set_permission_manager_contract_address and OpenZeppelin OwnableTwoStep plus IUpgradeable. The permission_manager_contract_address storage variable resolves to 0x7c7a6db2763d01aa889702bf5eb7b88a01a9df11da0e3d45c96a140c1f43ba3.

controls.label: USTBL Starknet owner multisig
controls.capDescription: Starknet token owner and PermissionManager DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder: can upgrade the token class, swap the permission-manager address, and holds MINTER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE and WHITELISTER_ROLE.
controls.evidence: At Starknet block 12085430 the USTBL token owner() returned this account; get_name() returned ArgentMultisig, get_version() returned 0.1.1, get_signers() returned five signers and get_threshold() returned 3. On the PermissionManager 0x7c7a6db2763d01aa889702bf5eb7b88a01a9df11da0e3d45c96a140c1f43ba3, has_role() at the same block returns true for DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE and WHITELISTER_ROLE and false for BURNER_ROLE, while the deploying account 0x60e1556d05eb19141a728424c604b875c60973df80af67b08c2c4c33ba4274f holds neither DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE nor MINTER_ROLE. get_role_admin(MINTER_ROLE) returns DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

controls.label: USTBL Stellar Soroban restricted mint/burn
controls.capDescription: Stellar Soroban USTBL token: mint and transfer eligibility are gated by the Spiko Soroban PermissionManager, and the contract Owner can replace the WASM and the permission-manager address.
controls.evidence: Soroban getLedgerEntries for the contract instance at ledger 63567141 returns executable WASM f48f10d9c7d35fc7783b5e27578bf0e764e3a30ff26a3bd7d8e57758c17a9ea8 and instance storage METADATA (Spiko US T-Bills Money Market Fund, USTBL, 5 decimals), PERM CBGHLRSX5D5YMBPNK4ZGMUTJUHFIT7YGXGJURM5LFNZ7B6WNSXLGS26M, REDEMP CAVZK26ERVGKGXLQGEOKPAQGIZS2YKN4BSXOYDMUY365EV66ZNSFEDBS, Owner GBYIQXBKEB655EB3WTRITS6RR5GXEP6SQRBLPREZHNFYKT7WBMTMPR3H and TotalSupply 3692200319236 (36,922,003.19236 shares). The issuer's own production address file publishes the same token and permission-manager contract ids.

controls.label: USTBL Stellar owner and PermissionManager admin account
controls.capDescription: Single Stellar account that is simultaneously the Soroban USTBL token Owner and the Soroban PermissionManager Admin: it can replace either contract's WASM and grant every permission role.
controls.evidence: The Soroban token instance Owner entry and the PermissionManager CBGHLRSX5D5YMBPNK4ZGMUTJUHFIT7YGXGJURM5LFNZ7B6WNSXLGS26M Admin entry both resolve to this account at ledger 63567141, and stellar.expert records it as the creator of both contracts. Horizon returns a single ed25519 signer of weight 1 with low, medium and high thresholds all 0 at ledger 63394470, so this is a single-key account with no quorum, unlike the 3-of-6 Safe on the EVM chains and the 3-of-5 Argent multisig on Starknet.

review.evidence: The three questions the previous review left open are now closed from primary chain reads. Arbitrum: at block 485896559 the PermissionManager mint requirement is mask 0x05, the upgrade requirement for both the token and the PermissionManager is mask 0x01, getGroupAdmins(0) is 0x01, and group-0 membership resolves to the single 3-of-6 Safe 0x7843225ba488cf780a4fe2c842b5dc2abcf8a03e; the six current operator-group members were each confirmed with getGroups(). The same re-read on Ethereum at block 25575138 shows the ADMIN group member is the 3-of-6 Safe 0x4eaa52b6280593a8820c45ce38f974290ae52cea and that the deploying EOA holds no group, correcting the earlier record that attributed mint and upgrade authority to an issuer EOA. Starknet: at block 12085430 the token owner is Argent multisig 0x07bc8bbd7c7fcc89273726fd34bc1ffc4649ed3f2f1be43e12afe8a406a5ca9d with five signers and threshold 3, and that account holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE and WHITELISTER_ROLE on PermissionManager 0x7c7a6db2763d01aa889702bf5eb7b88a01a9df11da0e3d45c96a140c1f43ba3 while the deployer holds none. Stellar: the issuer's own production address file names the token and permission-manager contracts, Soroban instance storage at ledger 63567141 gives token Owner and PermissionManager Admin as the same account GBYIQXBKEB655EB3WTRITS6RR5GXEP6SQRBLPREZHNFYKT7WBMTMPR3H, and Horizon shows that account has one signer of weight 1 with all thresholds 0. Supervision stays prudential because Spiko's fund is an AMF-authorized UCITS money-market fund with quarterly independent audit, but the Stellar single-key control is recorded as the weakest authority in the set rather than smoothed into the EVM and Starknet quorums.

reserveReview.rationale: The producer emits one 100% NAV identity for the regulated Spiko US T-Bills Money Market Fund. The KID and prospectus establish daily dealing, an explicit 180-day maximum residual maturity for eligible instruments, and a U.S.-government-instrument mandate. The prior 95/5 Treasury-bill and cash split was not a reported live allocation, so this review classifies the exact producer identity at the fund-share level.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact Chainlink NAV single-asset identity cross-checked against Spiko's current product page, prospectus, and KID
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No exposure outside the emitted fund NAV identity is indicated. Current security weights and operational settlement cash inside the regulated fund are not published by the NAV producer and are intentionally not represented as separate authored slices.

sources.label: Spiko US T-Bills Money Market Fund KID

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The KID identifies CACEIS Bank as custodian and states that the fund is separate from its management company and legally segregated from custodian assets; Spiko identifies BNY Mellon as sub-custodian for the U.S. Treasury bills. Provider shares, the broader delegated-custody chain, and rehypothecation terms are not published.
